insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, in case the available Sum Insured... is insufficient for covering a claim under the Policy as a result of previous claims in that Policy Year.
great.reference: Section C (I)(h) Reload of Sum Insured
great.explanation: Once in a policy year, the sum insured can be reloaded (as per the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table) if the available sum insured becomes insufficient due to earlier claims. This gives you extra coverage in the same year after you have already used up your base cover.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases and their direct complications are not covered for the first 24 months from the first policy start date. After 24 months of continuous coverage, PED-related claims become payable.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days from the policy commencement date, but accidents are covered immediately. This is a standard waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.explanation: Listed conditions/surgeries are not covered for the first 24 months from the first policy start date. Claims for these conditions become payable only after completing the 24-month waiting period.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: Such reloading of Sum Insured shall be available only once during a Policy Year... The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C (I)(h) Reload of Sum Insured, Conditions (ii) and (iii)
good.explanation: The reload is available only once in a policy year and only for subsequent claims, not for the same illness/injury (and its complications) already claimed in that year. This limits the reload to new, unrelated episodes within the same year.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Medical expenses for domiciliary hospitalization are covered up to the limits shown in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This helps when treatment is taken at home under conditions treated as hospitalization.

good.name: AYUSH Treatment
good.quote: We shall cover... towards the Medical Expenses for In-patient Hospitalization incurred with respect to the Insured Person’s Ayush Treatment undergone in any AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day care Center.
good.explanation: In-patient AYUSH treatment in an AYUSH hospital or AYUSH day care center is covered as per policy terms. This gives an option to claim for alternative systems of medicine when hospitalization is required.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Domestic Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Domestic emergency assistance services include air ambulance, subject to the policy’s terms and conditions. This can support faster medical evacuation in emergencies, though limits may apply elsewhere.

good.name: NCB
good.quote: The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 50% of the Sum Insured... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
good.explanation: No Claim Bonus can accumulate up to 50% of the sum insured, and after a claim it reduces by 10% of the sum insured at the next renewal. This is better than policies where the bonus resets to zero after a claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: If this option is chosen... discount of 10% on the premium... If the Insured Person takes Inpatient hospitalization treatment... in a Hospital other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 15% on each and every claim
bad.explanation: If you choose the PPN discount option, a 15% co-pay applies on each and every claim when hospitalized outside the Preferred Provider Network. This can materially increase out-of-pocket costs even on otherwise admissible claims.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent... up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy;
bad.reference: Section C (I)(a) In-patient Hospitalization, What is covered (1)
bad.explanation: Room rent is payable only up to the limit mentioned in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. If your chosen room category exceeds that limit, your claim payout can reduce and you may pay more yourself.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: If you take a room higher than your eligible category/limit, the insurer applies a rateable (proportionate) deduction on associated medical expenses. This can significantly reduce the claim amount paid even for non-room items like doctor and procedure charges.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Activ Care Policy Wordings - Annexure - I - List of Non-medical expenses... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure I – List of Non-medical expenses (List I)
bad.explanation: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure I (e.g., gloves, masks, and various kits) are not payable. This commonly leads to extra out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: Sublimit for listed illnesses: We will cover the Medical Expenses arising out of an Insured Person’s in-patient Hospitalization for the listed Illness/ conditions and limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table.
bad.reference: Section C (I)(j) Sublimit for listed illnesses
bad.explanation: Certain listed illnesses/conditions are covered only up to a sub-limit mentioned in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This can cap payouts for those conditions even if your overall sum insured is higher.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: if the Age (Age at entry) of the Insured Person or eldest Insured Person... is 61 years or above... shall bear a Co-payment per claim... as speciﬁed in Product Beneﬁt Table/Policy Schedule.
bad.explanation: If entry age is 61 years or above, a co-payment per claim applies as per the Product Benefit Table/Policy Schedule. This means you will pay a part of every admissible claim from your pocket, reducing effective coverage for seniors.

unclear.name: OPD Cover
unclear.quote: Waiting periods do not apply in respect of this Beneﬁt.
unclear.reference: Section C.II (o) OPD Treatment, Condition IV
unclear.explanation: No waiting period applies for the OPD treatment benefit. Whether OPD is included for you and the applicable limits depend on the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover... the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C (I)(b) Pre – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered as per the limits in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. The number of days and amount limits are not stated here, so you must check your schedule.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover... the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C (I)(c) Post – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered as per the limits in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. The number of days and amount limits are not stated here, so you must check your schedule.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless Facilities can be availed only at Our Network Providers/ Empanelled Service Providers. The complete list of Network Providers and Empaneled Service Providers is available on Our website
unclear.explanation: Cashless treatment is available only at the insurer’s network/empanelled providers listed on its website. The policy wording does not state the number of hospitals, so the network size cannot be judged from this extract.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
